y’imyitwarire mu Bushinjacyaha
bwa Gisirikare ifite ububasha
bukurikira:
(a) gusuzuma no gufata icyemezo
ku rwego rwa mbere ku makosa
yakozwe n’abofisiye
n’abasirikare batari abofisiye
bakora mu rukiko rwa gisirikare
cyangwa mu Bushinjacyaha
bwa Gisirikare, uretse Perezida
na Visi Perezida b’urukiko rwa
gisirikare, Umushinjacyaha
Mukuru wa Gisirikare
n’Umushinjacyaha Mukuru wa
Gisirikare Wungirije;
(b) gusuzuma no gufata icyemezo
ku bujurire bw’icyemezo
cyafashwe na Komite
y’imyitwarire ku rwego rwa
mbere.
(2) Ku rwego rwa mbere, Komite
y’imyitwarire mu rukiko rwa
gisirikare na Komite y’imyitwarire
mu Bushinjacyaha bwa Gisirikare
iyoborwa na Visi-Perezida cyangwa
Umushinjacyaha Mukuru wa
Gisirikare wungirije cyangwa undi
ofisiye Perezida w’urukiko rwa
gisirikare cyangwa
Umushinjacyaha Mukuru wa
Gisirikare yabihereye ububasha.
(3) Ku rwego rw’ubujurire, inteko ya
Komite y’imyitwarire mu rukiko
rwa gisirikare na Komite
y’imyitwarire mu Bushinjacyaha
bwa Gisirikare iyoborwa na
Perezida w’urukiko rwa gisirikare
cyangwa Umushinjacyaha Mukuru
wa Gisirikare cyangwa undi ofisiye
Perezida w’urukiko rwa gisirikare
cyangwa Umushinjacyaha Mukuru
wa Gisirikare yabihereye ububasha.
(4) Komite y’imyitwarire mu rukiko
rwa gisirikare na Komite
y’imyitwarire mu Bushinjacyaha
bwa Gisirikare ishobora
kwiyambaza undi muntu ufite
ubumenyi bwihariye iyo bibaye
ngombwa.
Icyiciro cya 9: Imitunganyirize,
ububasha n’imikorere bya Komite
y’imyitwarire muri Minisiteri y’Ingabo
no mu bigo biyishamikiyeho

articles.heading: Abagize Komite y’imyitwarire muri Minisiteri y’Ingabo Komite y’imyitwarire muri Minisiteri y’Ingabo igizwe n’aba bakurikira
Abagize Komite y’imyitwarire mu bigo bishamikiye kuri Minisiteri y’Ingabo (1) Komite y’imyitwarire mu bigo
Ububasha n’imikorere bya Komite y’imyitwarire muri Minisiteri y’Ingabo na Komite y’imyitwarire mu bigo biyishamikiyeho
articles.text:
(1) Komite y’imyitwarire muri
Minisiteri y’Ingabo na Komite
y’imyitwarire mu bigo
biyishamikiyeho ifite ububasha
bukurikira:
(a) gusuzuma no gufata icyemezo
ku rwego rwa mbere ku makosa
y’imyitwarire yakozwe
n’abofisiye, abasirikare batari
abofisiye n’abasivili bakora
muri Minisiteri y’Ingabo
cyangwa mu bigo
biyishamikiyeho, uretse
abayobozi bakuru muri
Minisiteri y’Ingabo,
n’abayobozi bakuru mu bigo
biyishamikiyeho
n’ababungirije;
(b) gusuzuma no gufata icyemezo
ku bujurire bw’icyemezo
cyafashwe na Komite
y’imyitwarire ku rwego rwa
mbere.
(2) Ku rwego rwa mbere, Komite
y’imyitwarire muri Minisiteri
y’Ingabo na Komite y’imyitwarire
mu bigo biyishamikiyeho iyoborwa
n’Umuyobozi Mukuru ushinzwe
ibikorwa rusange muri Minisiteri
y’Ingabo, Umuyobozi Mukuru
wungirije mu bigo bishamikiye kuri
Minisiteri y’Ingabo cyangwa undi
ofisiye Umunyamabanga Uhoraho
cyangwa Umuyobozi Mukuru
yabihereye ububasha.
(3) Ku rwego rw’ubujurire, inteko ya
Komite y’imyitwarire muri
Minisiteri y’Ingabo na Komite
y’imyitwarire mu bigo
biyishamikiyeho iba igizwe
n’abofisiye ikayoborwa
n’Umunyamabanga Uhoraho muri
Minisiteri y’Ingabo cyangwa
Umuyobozi Mukuru cyangwa undi
ofisiye Umunyamabanga Uhoraho
muri Minisiteri y’Ingabo cyangwa
Umuyobozi Mukuru mu kigo
kiyishamikiyeho yabihereye
ububasha.
(4) Komite y’imyitwarire ishyirwaho
n’Umunyamabanga Uhoraho muri
Minisiteri y’Ingabo isuzuma ku
rwego rwa mbere n’urwa nyuma
amakosa y’imyitwarire yakozwe
n’abayobozi bakuru muri Minisiteri
y’Ingabo n’ayakozwe n’abayobozi
bakuru mu bigo bishamikiye kuri
Minisiteri y’Ingabo n’ababungirije.
(5) Iyo Ikigo gishamikiye kuri
Minisiteri y’Ingabo kidafite
umubare wa ngombwa usabwa
w’abasirikare kugira ngo Komite
y’imyitwarire iterane, idosiye
y’umusirikare bireba yohererezwa
Komite y’imyitwarire ya Minisiteri
y’Ingabo.
(6) Komite y’imyitwarire muri
Minisiteri y’Ingabo na Komite
y’imyitwarire mu bigo
biyishamikiyeho ishobora
kwiyambaza undi muntu ufite
ubumenyi bwihariye iyo bibaye
ngombwa.
Icyiciro cya 10: Imitunganyirize,
ububasha n’imikorere bya Komite
y’imyitwarire mu Biro by’Abajyanama
Bakuru n’amashami byo ku Buyobozi
Bukuru bwa RDF

articles.heading: Abagize Komite y’imyitwarire mu Biro by’Abajyanama Bakuru n’amashami byo ku Buyobozi Bukuru bwa RDF
articles.text:
Komite y’imyitwarire mu Biro
by’Abajyanama Bakuru n’amashami byo
ku Buyobozi Bukuru bwa RDF igizwe
n’aba bakurikira:
(a) Umuyobozi w’Ibiro
by’Abajyanama Bakuru cyangwa
Umuyobozi w’Ishami, Perezida;
(b) Umuyobozi ushyirwaho
n’Umuyobozi w’Ibiro
by’Abajyanama Bakuru cyangwa
n’Umuyobozi w’Ishami;
(c) Abofisiye babiri bashyirwaho
n’Umuyobozi w’Ibiro
by’Abajyanama Bakuru cyangwa
n’Umuyobozi w’Ishami;
(d) Suzofisiye ushyirwaho
n’Umuyobozi w’Ibiro
by’Abajyanama Bakuru cyangwa
Umuyobozi w’Ishami;
Umwanditsi.

articles.heading: Ububasha n’imikorere bya Komite y’imyitwarire mu Biro by’Abajyanama Bakuru n’amashami byo ku Buyobozi Bukuru bwa RDF
articles.text:
(1) Komite y’imyitwarire mu Biro
by’Abajyanama Bakuru
n’amashami byo ku Buyobozi
Bukuru bwa RDF isuzuma kandi
igafata icyemezo ku makosa
y’imyitwarire yakozwe
n’abasirikare bakorera muri ibyo
Biro by’Abajyanama Bakuru
cyangwa muri ayo mashami.
(2) Ku rwego rwa mbere, inteko
iyoborwa na ofisiye ufite uburambe
kurusha abandi.
(3) Ku rwego rw’ubujurire, inteko
iyoborwa n’Umuyobozi w’Ibiro
by’Abajyanama Bakuru, uw’Ishami
cyangwa undi ofisiye, Umuyobozi
w’Ibiro by’Abajyanama Bakuru,
cyangwa uw’Ishami yabihereye
ububasha.
Icyiciro cya 11: Imitunganyirize,
ububasha n’imikorere bya Komite
y’imyitwarire mu Biro by’Umugaba
Mukuru w’Ingabo, mu by’Abagaba
b’Ingabo no mu by’Umugenzuzi
Mukuru

articles.heading: Abagize Komite y’imyitwarire mu Biro by’Umugaba Mukuru w’Ingabo, mu by’Abagaba b’Ingabo no mu by’Umugenzuzi
Ububasha n’imikorere bya Komite y’imyitwarire mu Biro by’Umugaba Mukuru w’Ingabo, mu by’Abagaba b’Ingabo no mu
articles.text:
by’Umugenzuzi Mukuru
(1) Komite y’imyitwarire mu Biro
by’Umugaba Mukuru w’Ingabo, mu
by’Abagaba b’Ingabo no mu
by’Umugenzuzi Mukuru ifite
ububasha bukurikira:
(a) gusuzuma no gufata icyemezo
ku rwego rwa mbere ku makosa
y’imyitwarire yakozwe
n’abasirikare bakorera mu Biro
by’Umugaba Mukuru
w’Ingabo, mu by’Abagaba
b’Ingabo no mu
by’Umugenzuzi Mukuru;
(b) gusuzuma no gufata icyemezo
ku bujurire bw’icyemezo
cyafashwe na Komite
y’imyitwarire ku rwego rwa
mbere.
(2) Ku rwego rwa mbere, inteko
iyoborwa na ofisiye ufite uburambe
kurusha abandi, Umuyobozi uva mu
Ishami ry’Amategeko rya RDF
akayibera umwanditsi.
(3) Ku rwego rw’ubujurire, inteko iba
igizwe n’abasirikare bakurikira:
(a) Umujyanama mu Biro Bikuru
bya mbere, Perezida;
(b) Umujyanama mu Biro Bikuru
bya cyenda;
(c) Umuyobozi w’Ishami
ry’Amategeko muri RDF,
Umwanditsi.
Icyiciro cya 12: Imitunganyirize,
ububasha n’imikorere bya Komite
y’imyitwarire ku rwego rw’Ubuyobozi
Bukuru bwa RDF

articles.heading: Abagize Komite y’imyitwarire ku rwego rw’Ubuyobozi Bukuru bwa RDF Komite y’imyitwarire ku rwego
articles.text:
rw’Ubuyobozi Bukuru bwa RDF igizwe
n’inzego ebyiri zikurikira:
(a) ku rwego rwa mbere, Komite
y’imyitwarire igizwe
n’abasirikare bakurikira:
(i) umwe mu Bagaba b’Ingabo
bireba, Perezida;
(ii) ba Jenerali babiri
bashyirwaho n’Umugaba
Mukuru w’Ingabo;
(iii)Koloneli umwe ushyirwaho
n’Umugaba Mukuru
w’Ingabo, Umwanditsi;
(b) ku rwego rw’ubujurire, Komite
y’imyitwarire igizwe
n’abasirikare bakurikira:
(i) Umugaba Mukuru w’Ingabo
cyangwa undi ofisiye
yabihereye ububasha,
Perezida;
(ii) Umugaba w’Ingabo
zirwanira ku Butaka;
(iii)Umugaba w’Ingabo
zirwanira mu Kirere;
(iv)Umugaba w’Ingabo
zishinzwe Ubuzima;
(v) Umugaba w’Ingabo
z’Inkeragutabara;
(vi)Umujyanama mu Biro
Bikuru bya mbere,
Umwanditsi.

articles.heading: Ububasha n’imikorere bya Komite y’imyitwarire ku rwego rw’Ubuyobozi Bukuru bwa RDF (1) Komite y’imyitwarire ku rwego
articles.text:
rw’Ubuyobozi Bukuru bwa RDF
ifite ububasha bwo –
(a) gusuzuma no gufata icyemezo
ku rwego rwa mbere ku makosa
y’imyitwarire yakozwe
n’abasirikare bakurikira:
(i) Umuyobozi w’Umutwe
ushinzwe kurinda Inzego
Nkuru z’Igihugu,
uw’Umutwe w’Ingabo
wihariye, uwa diviziyo,
uwa command, uwa Air
Group, uw’Inkeragutabara
ku rwego rw’Intara
n’ababungirije;
(ii) Umuyobozi wa akademi,
uw’ishuri n’uwa koleji bya
gisirikare, Umuyobozi
w’Icyicaro Gikuru,
Umuyobozi Mukuru
w’Ibitaro bya Gisirikare
byigisha by’u Rwanda
n’ababungirije;
(iii) Perezida na Visi Perezida
b’urukiko rwa gisirikare,
Umushinjacyaha Mukuru
wa Gisirikare
n’umwungirije;
(iv) ba Jenerali;
(v) Abayobozi b’Ibiro
by’Abajyanama Bakuru
n’ab’amashami mu
Buyobozi Bukuru bwa
RDF;
(vi) Ofisiye ushinzwe ibikorwa
bya Gisirikare mu Ngabo
zirwanira mu Kirere;
(vii) Umuyobozi wa Air Force
Protection Brigade;
(viii) Umuyobozi wa rejima;
(ix) undi ofisiye uri mu
mwanya w’Ubuyobozi
Bukuru utavuzwe muri aka
gaka;
(b) n’ubwo gusuzuma no gufata
icyemezo ku bujurire
bw’ibyemezo Komite
y’imyitwarire yafatiye
abasirikare bavugwa mu gaka ka
(a) ku rwego rwa mbere.
(2) Komite y’imyitwarire ku rwego
rw’Ubuyobozi Bukuru bwa RDF
ishobora kwiyambaza Umuyobozi
w’Ishami ry’ubutasi muri RDF
cyangwa Umuyobozi w’Ishami
ry’amategeko mu Buyobozi Bukuru
bwa RDF iyo bibaye ngombwa.
UMUTWE WA IV: AMAKOSA
N’IBIHANO BY’IMYITWARIRE
Icyiciro cya mbere: Ibihano
by’imyitwarire n’itangwa ryabyo

articles.heading: Akamaro k’igihano cy’imyitwarire (1) Igihano cy’imyitwarire kigamije gukosora umusirikare kugira ngo
articles.text:
habeho imyifatire myiza muri RDF.
(2) Birabujijwe gukoresha igihano
cy’imyitwarire hagamijwe
guhohotera umusirikare.

articles.heading: Ibihano by’imyitwarire bihabwa abofisiye Hakurikijwe uburemere bw’ikosa ry’imyitwarire, ibihano by’imyitwarire
Ibihano by’imyitwarire bihabwa abasuzofisiye Hakurikijwe uburemere bw’ikosa ry’imyitwarire, ibihano by’imyitwarire
Ibihano by’imyitwarire bihabwa abasirikare bato Hakurikijwe uburemere bw’ikosa ry’imyitwarire, ibihano by’imyitwarire
Amakosa akomeye ahanishwa kwirukanwa Amakosa akomeye ahanishwa kwirukanwa muri RDF ni aya akurikira
Itangwa ry’igihano cy’imyitwarire (1) Uretse igihe umusirikare wa RDF yirukanywe n’Umugaba w’Ikirenga
articles.text:
wa RDF kubera ikosa rikomeye,
igihano cy’imyitwarire ntigishobora
gutangwa iyo Komite y’imyitwarire
itaremeza ko ukekwa ahamwa
n’ikosa.
(2) Kwirukana umusirikare muri RDF
kubera ikosa rikomeye bishyirwa
mu bikorwa iyo inzira z’ubujurire
ziteganywa muri iri teka zirangiye
kandi byemejwe n’Umugaba
w’Ikirenga wa RDF.

articles.heading: Uburyo bwo gufata icyemezo cyo kwirukanwa (1) Icyemezo cyo kwirukanwa cyafashwe na Komite y’imyitwarire
articles.text:
ku rwego rwa mbere gishobora
kujuririrwa ku rwego rwisumbuye
mu gihe kitarenze iminsi 15 ibarwa
uhereye ku munsi icyemezo
cyafatiwe.
(2) Iyo kwirukanwa bigumishijweho
mu bujurire, icyemezo
gishyikirizwa Inama y’Abakuru ba
RDF kugira ngo ibyemeze binyuze
mu nzira isanzwe y’uruhererekane
rw’amabwiriza.
(3) Iyo Inama y’Abakuru ba RDF imaze
kwemeza urutonde rw’abasirikare
basabirwa kwirukanwa, icyo
cyemezo gishyikirizwa Minisitiri.
(4) Minisitiri yoherereza Umugaba
w’Ikirenga wa RDF urutonde
rwemejwe rw’abasirikare basabirwa
kwirukanwa kugira ngo afate
umwanzuro ndakuka.
(5) Urutonde rw’abasirikare bagomba
kwirukanwa rwemejwe n’Umugaba
w’Ikirenga wa RDF rwohererezwa
Umugaba Mukuru wa RDF kugira
ngo igihano gihite gishyirwa mu
bikorwa.

articles.heading: Ibihano by’imyitwarire bitangwa n’abayobozi ba gisirikare (1) Abayobozi ba gisirikare bashobora
articles.text:
gutanga ibihano byoroheje
by’imyitwarire ku basirikare bato
ku myitwarire mibi yoroheje. Ibyo
bihano by’imyitwarire byoroheje ni
ibi bikurikira:
(a) kubahatira gukora isuku mu
kigo cya gisikare;
(b) gukoresha imyitozo
ngororamubiri ihagarikiwe; no
(c) kugawa mu ruhame.
(2) Ibihano by’imyitwarire biteganywa
mu gika cya (1) –
(a) ntibigomba kuba uburyo bwo
kubangamira ubuzima cyangwa
guhohotera umusirikare
wabihawe;
(b) ntibishyirwa mu idosiye
y’umusirikare wahanwe;
(c) ntibijuririrwa;
(d) ntibigira ingaruka ku iterambere
mu mwuga ry’umusirikare;
(e) kandi bitangwa mu gihe
kitarenze iminsi itatu uhereye
igihe ikosa ry’imyitwarire
ryakorewe cyangwa igihe
uwarikoze abonekeye.

articles.heading: Ibihano n’uburemere bw’ikosa ry’imyitwarire (1) Ikosa ry’imyitwarire rihanishwa kimwe cyangwa bibiri mu bihano
articles.text:
biteganywa mu ngingo ya 55, iya 56
n’iya 57 bitewe n’uburemere
bwaryo n’uko uwarikoze yari
asanzwe yitwara.
(2) Uburemere bw’ikosa ry’imyitwarire
n’igihano bikwiranye bigenwa
hitawe ku buryo ryakozwemo
n’ingaruka ryateje cyangwa ryateza.

articles.heading: Impamvu zoroshya uburemere bw’ikosa ry’imyitwarire Uburemere bw’ikosa ry’imyitwarire bushobora koroshywa n’impamvu imwe
articles.text:
cyangwa nyinshi muri izi zikurikira:
(a) kwirega no gusaba imbabazi ku
ikosa ry’imyitwarire umusirikare
yakoze mbere y’uko akurikiranwa;
(b) iyo gukora ikosa ry’imyitwarire
byasembuwe;
(c) iyo ikosa ry’imyitwarire ryakozwe
nta ngaruka zikomeye ryateje;
(d) iyo ari bwo bwa mbere ahamwe
n’ikosa ry’imyitwarire kandi akaba
yari asanzwe agaragaza imyitwarire
myiza.

articles.heading: Impamvu zongera uburemere bw’ikosa ry’imyitwarire Uburemere bw’ikosa ry’imyitwarire bushobora kongerwa n’impamvu imwe
articles.text:
cyangwa nyinshi muri izi zikurikira:
(a) impurirane y’amakosa
y’imyitwarire;
(b) isubirakosa ry’imyitwarire ribaye
mu gihe kitarenze umwaka umwe;
(c) ikosa ry’imyitwarire ryakozwe
ryateje ingaruka zikomeye;
(d) ikosa ry’imyitwarire rikozwe
n’abantu bishyize hamwe.
Icyiciro cya 2: Gutegura idosiye, gutanga
ibisobanuro, kumenyeshwa icyemezo no
kujurira

articles.heading: Gutegura idosiye Idosiye y’umusirikare ukurikiranyweho ikosa ry’imyitwarire itegurwa, ikohererezwa kandi igasobanurirwa Komite
articles.text:
y’imyitwarire na ofisiye ushinzwe
iperereza, n’ushinzwe umutekano cyangwa
n’undi wabiherewe ububasha n’ubuyobozi
bubifitiye ububasha.

articles.heading: Gutanga ibisobanuro Komite y’imyitwarire ntishobora gufatira icyemezo umusirikare ukurikiranyweho
articles.text:
ikosa ry’imyitwarire ataratanga
ibisobanuro. Icyakora, Komite
y’imyitwarire ishobora gufatira umusirikare
icyemezo adahari iyo yabuze mu mutwe
abarirwamo nta kiruhuko cyangwa
uruhushya yahawe.

articles.heading: Ifatwa n’imenyeshwa ry’icyemezo cya Komite y’imyitwarire (1) Komite y’imyitwarire ifatira icyemezo mu muhezo nyuma yo
articles.text:
kumva ibisobanuro by’umusirikare
ukurikiranyweho ikosa
ry’imyitwarire.
(2) Uretse ibihano ku makosa
y’imyitwarire yoroheje bitangwa
n’abayobozi ba gisirikare, Komite
y’imyitwarire imenyesha mu
nyandiko umusirikare wahanwe
ibindi bihano by’imyitwarire mu
gihe kitarenze amasaha 24 akurikira
ifatwa ry’icyemezo, igaha kopi
inzego z’ubuyobozi zishinzwe
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’ibihano
by’imyitwarire.

articles.heading: Ubujurire (1) Umusirikare wahanwe mu rwego rw’imyitwarire afite uburenganzira bwo kujurira mu gihe kitarenze
articles.text:
amasaha 24 nyuma yo
kumenyeshwa umwanzuro.
Ubujurire bukorwa mu nyandiko
cyangwa mu magambo bukandikwa
mu gitabo cyabugenewe.
(2) Komite y’imyitwarire ku rwego
rw’ubujurire iterana mu gihe
kitarenze amasaha 72 abarwa
uhereye ku munsi yakiriye ubujurire
kugira ngo ibusuzume. Komite
y’imyitwarire ku rwego
rw’ubujurire ifata icyemezo mu
gihe kitarenze amasaha 24 uhereye
igihe yateraniye kugira ngo isuzume
ubujurire.
(3) Igihe giteganyijwe mu gika cya (2)
gishobora kongerwa iyo hari
impamvu zifatika zabiteye. Komite
y’imyitwarire bireba isobanura izo
mpamvu mu cyemezo cyayo.
(4) Ubujurire buba rimwe gusa.

articles.heading: Kumenyeshwa icyemezo ndakuka (1) Komite y’imyitwarire imenyesha umusirikare bireba mu nyandiko
articles.text:
icyemezo ndakuka yafashe kandi
igaha kopi yacyo inzego
A
z’ubuyobozi zishinzwe ishyirwa mu
bikorwa ry’ibihano by’imyitwarire
mu gihe kitarenze iminsi irindwi
ikurikira ifatwa ryacyo, kandi icyo
cyemezo kigashyirwa mu idosiye
y’uwo musirikare bireba.
(2) Inzego z’ubuyobozi zishinzwe
ishyirwa mu bikorwa ry’ibihano
by’imyitwarire ni izi zikurikira:
(a) Ibiro by’Abajyanama Bakuru
bya mbere;
(b) Umutwe umusirikare
abarirwamo;
(c) Urwego rwa Gisirikare
rushinzwe imyitwarire.
Icyiciro cya 3: Ububasha bwa Komite
y’imyitwarire iyo hari ikurikiranacyaha,
impamvu zituma gukurikirana ikosa
ry’imyitwarire n’igihano cy’imyitwarire
bizima n’ihanagurabusembwa

articles.heading: Ububasha bwa Komite y’imyitwarire iyo hari ikurikiranacyaha Komite y’imyitwarire ifite ububasha bwo
articles.text:
guhana umusirikare wakoze ikosa
ry’imyitwarire ititaye ku byavuye mu
ikurikiranacyaha.

articles.heading: Impamvu zituma gukurikirana ikosa ry’imyitwarire n’ibihano bizima (1) Gukurikirana ikosa ry’imyitwarire
Ubusaze bwo gukurikirana ikosa ry’imyitwarire n’ubw’igihano (1) Ubusaze bwo gukurikirana ikosa
articles.text:
ry’imyitwarire ni amezi atatu ku
musirikare uri mu Gihugu
n’umwaka umwe ku musirikare uri
hanze y’Igihugu.
(2) Ubusaze bw’igihano cy’imyitwarire
ni amezi atandatu ku musirikare uri
mu Gihugu cyangwa hanze
y’Igihugu.

articles.heading: Ihanagurabusembwa (1) Umusirikare wirukanywe kubera guhanishwa igifungo cy’iminsi 30 inshuro eshatu mu gihe cy’imyaka
articles.text:
itatu ikurikirana ashobora guhabwa
ihanagurabusembwa nyuma
y’imyaka ibiri n’Umugaba Mukuru
wa RDF.
(2) Umusirikare wirukanywe kubera
ikosa rikomeye ashobora guhabwa
ihanagurabusembwa nyuma
y’imyaka itanu n’Umugaba Mukuru
wa RDF.
(3) Umusirikare wirukanywe asaba
ihanagurabusembwa yandikiye
Umugaba Mukuru wa RDF. Ubwo
busabe bugaragaza umunsi
yahaniweho kandi usaba atanga
icyemezo cy’imyitwarire myiza
yahawe n’ubuyobozi bw’Akagari
atuyemo.

articles.heading: Amakosa y’imyitwarire yatangiye gukurikiranwa Ikosa ry’imyitwarire ryakozwe igihe Iteka rya Minisitiri nº 01/Minadef/2012 ryo ku
articles.text:

gukorwa hakurikijwe uburyo buteganywa
n’iryo teka, ariko ikosa rigahanwa
hakurikijwe ibiteganywa n’iri teka.
